concepts.def: German industrial designer chief of design at Braun from 1961 to 1995, whose products shaped consumer electronics aesthetics.
Rams's list of qualities of good design, articulated in the 1970s and 1980s, including innovative, useful and aesthetic.
First of Rams's principles stating that good design uses new technological possibilities to develop genuinely original solutions.
Rams's principle that good design serves the user's needs, satisfying functional, psychological and aesthetic criteria.
Rams's principle that good design does not promise more than it can deliver, avoiding deceptive styling.
Rams's tenth principle advocating reduction to the essential, profoundly influencing Jonathan Ive's work at Apple.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Designing & Making Principles — a core area of GCSE Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Designing & Making Principles brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Designing & Making Principles.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
